title: How can I add loop animations using PNG images and have the animation removed using a ''Show choice'' or some switch or variable?

posts.author: Litroxx28
posts.body: Hello friends, I am making a game in RPG Maker MV and I want to add animations using PNG, only I don't know how to add them in Loop and with some other option the animation can be removed, another person told me that they only used parallel, switch and variables, I just don't know how to use them when adding an animation, I hope you can help me.
